    const int IA = 3877;

    static byte[] BuildMap(char[] symbols, double[] probs)
    {
        int n = symbols.Length;
        double[] cum = new double[n];
        double sum = 0;
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++)
        {
            sum += probs[i];
            cum[i] = sum;
        }
        byte[] map = new byte[IM];
        for (int s = 0; s < IM; s++)

            double r = s / (double)IM;
            int idx = 0;
            while (idx < n && !(cum[idx] > r)) idx++;
            if (idx == n) idx = n - 1;
            map[s] = (byte)symbols[idx];
        }
        return map;
    }

        int[] packed = new int[IM];
        for (int s = 0; s < IM; s++)
        {
            int ns = nextSeed[s];
            packed[s] = (ns << 8) | map[ns];
        }
        return packed;
